address: Capella, 139 Dunhua North Road, Songshan District, Taipei, 105021, Taiwan
bio: The dining room with the ceiling covered in faux red brick evokes a modern yet warm Chinese home. In 2026, under the helm of a chef with an international background, the kitchen introduced a subtle contemporary touch to the cuisine. The set menus remain anchored in Cantonese classics, but are thoughtfully updated with modern twists and premium ingredients such as lobster dim sum with truffle and stir-fried Shandong cabbage with sakura ebi. The tea selection and pairing are well curated – order a pot for a harmonious complement to the meal.
